name: vibe-coder
description: Day-to-day coding habits: Tailscale links instead of localhost for anything running on this machine, context-saving rules for every coding task, a hunter that finds implicit state machines and makes them explicit, a bug triager that only fixes bugs worth fixing, and two pre-launch checks for vibe-coded sites (launch-ready for the pages, launch-safe for keys, billing abuse, payments, monitoring and launch day), each auditing with five read-only subagents and fixing the approved issues in one pass. Add vibe-coder-local for the improve retro and the output-trimming hook.
